title: A Complete part sale deletes, but received parts still block it
custom_preconds:
1. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  2. Three objects. Seed them:
  3. ↳ A part sale at Complete with NO received parts (create a sale, set status to Complete without receiving).
  4. ↳ A part sale holding received parts (create a sale, Order and Receive a part).
  5. ↳ A Complete service work order (Work Orders -> New Work Order, taken to Complete).
  6. Signed in with Part sales -> Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. On the Complete part sale with no received parts, open the menu -> Delete Part Sale and confirm.
  2. On the part sale holding received parts, try Delete Part Sale and read the refusal message.
  3. On the Complete service work order, try to delete it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Complete part sale with no received parts deletes successfully (the old rule that blocked deleting a Complete document is gone).
  • The part sale holding received parts is refused with "Part sale cannot be deleted because it has received parts. Please return or reassign all received parts before deleting."
  • The Complete service work order still cannot be deleted (unchanged).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10265 (Read the part sale log, and a menu that stops putting Delete first); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 4; design canvas boards S4_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R5: “A part sale can be deleted while it is Complete. Complete means something different on a part sale ... so refusing to delete a Complete document made every received part sale permanently undeletable”
  • S4-N3: “A part sale holding received parts still cannot be deleted. It is refused with “Part sale cannot be deleted because it has received parts. Please return or reassign all received parts before deleting.” That rule is unchanged; it was simply unreachable behind the Complete check”
  • S4-N4: “A service work order is unchanged. A Complete one still cannot be deleted”

Last checked against build v26.39.2-210868d on 10/1/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
